help.title: How the rota works
help.lede: The food bank runs three shifts a day, Monday to Saturday.
help.places: Every shift needs two volunteers: a shift with nobody is Open, with one it needs one more, with two it is Full.
help.week: Nobody may be rostered for more than 12 hours in a Monday to Sunday week.
help.day: Each volunteer takes at most one shift a day.
help.past: Days that have passed are kept as a record and can no longer be changed.
help.withdraw: Volunteers withdraw from a shift on their own page; the place goes back on the rota.
